I am writing to refer this patient under the prostate suspected cancer pathway. He has a significant history of lower urinary tract symptoms over the past six months: poor flow, hesitancy, frequency, and nocturia twice per night. On examination his prostate is firm, enlarged, with an abnormal prostate examination on the right side -- a suspicious hard nodule is palpable.
